summary.text: Shane R. Martin is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 13, which covers Greenville, Spartanburg and Union Counties, serving since 2009.
He chairs the Senate Corrections and Penology Committee.

paragraphs.text: Martin was born in 1971 in Spartanburg and is an engineer and business owner.
His official page lists a B.S. from Clemson University in 1994 and an M.S. in 1999.
He served on the Spartanburg County School District Six board of trustees beginning in 2005 and has been in the Senate since 2009.
His committees are Corrections and Penology (chairman), Finance, Medical Affairs and Rules.
